module.name: prompt
module.purpose: Loads, validates, injects, and renders named prompt templates and reusable prompt modules, including whole-current-task action classification, exact-current-task completion evidence, verbatim-value summarization requirements, earlier-chunk fact recaps, and optional cursor-return guidance for tool-call summaries.

childModules.name: module
childModules.purpose: Defines reusable prompt fragments embedded into rendered templates: RepeatInvocation warns that an identical tool call was already requested, PreChunk notes that the listed facts came from earlier chunks of the same tool output so only new facts should be stated, and CompletedCalls identifies exact-current-task call results as confirmed evidence.

childModules.name: template
childModules.purpose: Defines System, WorkflowPolicy, ToolCallSummarize, and ToolCallSummarizeWithCursor resources; System and WorkflowPolicy classify the complete current task as confirmed complete, explicitly infeasible, an exact one-tool match, or a multi-stage Plan while excluding parent work, and both summarize resources carry their whole instruction block ahead of the variable payload so the cacheable prefix stays stable, require every relevant fact with concrete values copied verbatim and JSON-safe escaping, open with an optional pre_chunk block, and fence the tool output in a triple-backtick code block, while only the WithCursor variant asks for a continuation cursor and the plain variant states that no further chunks follow.
